purpose: Teach: 琉球/盛岡/大宮/八王子/ケンブリッジ/シベリア/サンパウロ/平壌

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で琉球王国習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you studied the Ryukyu Kingdom in social studies, right?
lines.style: Playful accusation — testing to see if he remembers. Quick tempo, slight teasing lilt on the question. Eyes bright. Comfortable needling between friends.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、盛岡わんこそば挑戦したろ?桜
lines.en: You tried the Morioka wanko-soba challenge, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Mirror her teasing back at her with a small smile. Light, knowing tone. Deliberately casual, like he's been waiting to land this one. Relaxed shoulders.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、大宮アルディージャ応援してたな
lines.en: Riku, you were cheering for Omiya Ardija back then, weren't you?
lines.style: Gentle tease with a hint of fondness underneath. Slower pace than before — not accusatory, more like she's remembering something small and sweet about him. Softer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、八王子の塾通ってたな、桜
lines.en: You went to that cram school in Hachioji, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact recall. Not teasing anymore — just stating what he knows about her. Calm observation. A beat of connection underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ケンブリッジ大学志望だな
lines.en: Riku, you're aiming for Cambridge, aren't you?
lines.style: Direct, genuine curiosity beneath the teasing. Slight lift at the end — not quite a question, more like she's acknowledging something real about him. Sincere.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でシベリア抑留習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned about Siberian internment in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet shift in tone — the game continues but with less lightness. He's referencing something heavier. Measured pace. Eye contact level rises slightly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でサンパウロ習ったな
lines.en: Riku, didn't you study São Paulo in social studies?
lines.style: Back to lightness but not quite the beginning brightness. Testing if he's tracking her line of questioning. Curious, almost leading.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ニュースで平壌のお話気になってたな、桜
lines.en: You were interested when the news talked about Pyongyang, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Very close now — intimate recognition. Slow, careful delivery. He's naming something she probably didn't think he noticed. Tender beneath the surface.
